verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's own storage and APIs use open, standard interfaces. AI Object Storage is S3-compatible, objects can be downloaded directly from the Cloud Console, and usage data can be exported programmatically via the FOCUS API. Workloads run on standard managed Kubernetes, reachable with kubectl via kubeconfig and defined in Terraform/OpenTofu, which makes leaving plausible. However, there is no documented 'export all data' or offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export or offboarding/exit process, account deletion and data-deletion guarantees, egress terms for moving data out, and independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating off.
